draft.title: Hypothetical: Q4 vs. Q8 Quantization - Memory vs. Accuracy Trade-offs
draft.body:
This post outlines a hypothetical comparison between Q4 and Q8 quantization levels for local LLMs, focusing on potential resource and performance trade-offs. The scenario posits that a Q4 configuration might use 6 GB of memory, while a Q8 configuration could require 10 GB.

In a simulated 20-question assessment, with identical hardware and prompts, the hypothetical Q4 model achieved 14 correct answers, and the Q8 model achieved 16 correct answers. This suggests a potential accuracy benefit with Q8, albeit at a higher memory cost.

It is critical to emphasize that this is a purely hypothetical exploration based on synthetic data. No actual benchmarks or significance tests were conducted. These figures are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent measured results or personal experience. We are interested in discussing how these hypothetical trade-offs might play out in practice.
